Riverpoint Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 41.66% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Riverpoint Capital Management Llc sold 37,098 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 51,953 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.72 million, down from 89,051 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Riverpoint Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $942.87 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.84% or $1.59 $191.83. About 24.84 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
